overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed outcome.detail would be unique across all outcomes in all case studies, but multiple case studies can have the same placeholder detail text.
why_it_breaks: When replacing Math.random() keys, the agent chose outcome.detail as the key, but since there are 3 case studies each with placeholder outcomes that share the same detail text '[Outcome — what changed.]', React sees 6 children with identical keys across the three study cards, triggering the duplicate key warning 6 times.
